subject.declared_domain: The ontology rail sitting between C1 and C2: a composed DIRECTED TYPED PATH -- the ordered hops a value takes, each hop's EdgeKind transform, and the CADENCE the path is contracted to run at. Its declared contribution over C2 is exactly three things: DIRECTION, TRANSFORM, TIME. This card covers the rail's definition and the live substrate beneath those three. It explicitly does NOT re-derive C2 motif membership -- the rail's own seed states it 'does not re-implement motif membership', and C2 is 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~X's subject (SC-c-*).

methodology.how: A hand-authored static YAML block in the ontology rule bank, resolved BY HOME exactly as D1 is. It COMPOSES the ratified C2 motif topology (the un-timed shapes), D1's EdgeKind semantic (supplying the per-hop transform), the graph's native edge direction, and D3's delivery_cadence obligation (supplying time). It INVENTS the composition itself -- the path object as an ordered hop list carrying transform and cadence -- and the declaration that cadence is forward-where-undeclared. NO GENERATOR EXISTS and no code implements a path object: nothing in the repo assembles this block or materialises a D2 path, so 'how it comes to exist' is a human edit plus a registered SYSTEM_DEFINITIONS version bump. The counts embedded under graph_evidence were produced by a comp-kuzu census at a pinned vintage and are stamped TRUE-AT-THAT-VINTAGE by the block's own as_of key.

verdict.why: The rail contributes three things over C2 -- DIRECTION, TRANSFORM, TIME -- and they are NOT in the same state, which is the whole finding. DIRECTION is native and sound (CloudEdge is directed; the transitive closure is computable today). TRANSFORM is native and measurably intact (the inherited EdgeKind split reproduces exactly at 337/142/482, summing to 961). TIME is structurally unresolved: cadence is not a graph primitive by design, it is sourced from D3, and D3 supplies a cadence value for 1 of 14 landed contract records -- with 4 records declaring the delivery_cadence obligation while only 1 carries the value that makes it checkable. So the rail is fully standable for provenance and blast-radius work (both licensed derivations that need only direction and grain) and NOT standable for freshness, which is its headline derivation and which degrades silently rather than failing. QUALIFIED rather than UNSOUND because two of three axes are sound and the third fails in a NAMED, bounded way; QUALIFIED rather than SOUND because a consumer who does not know which axis they are standing on will get a well-formed freshness answer computed over an empty time axis. NOT INCOMPLETE: all 7 rows are worked and carry measured bases. Per QUALIFY-DO-NOT-FIX this lane remediated nothing, edited no rail, and committed no change to any carded surface.
blocking_defects: For freshness or any time-dependent derivation: the cadence input resolves for 1 of 14 D3 records and degrades silently to forward-where-undeclared over the rest. Do not compute freshness from a D2 path without checking the path's contract carries a cadence value. Owners 4.0.0_SA_CRO and 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~D.
